#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
# Hierarchical Bayesian binomial model, fit with rstan::sampling
#
#   y_i     ~ Binomial(n_i, theta_i)
#   theta_i ~ Beta(alpha, beta)
#   p(alpha, beta) prop (alpha + beta)^(-5/2)
#
# Settings: 4 chains, 100,000 iterations per chain, seed = 1

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(rstan))

options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())

## ---- data ----
dat <- read.csv("/app/data.csv")
model_data <- list(
  N = nrow(dat),
  y = as.integer(dat$y),
  n = as.integer(dat$n)
)

## ---- compile the Stan model (cached in /app on reruns) ----
model <- rstan::stan_model(
  file = "/app/hierarchical_model.stan",
  auto_write = TRUE
)

## ---- posterior sampling: 4 chains x 100,000 iterations, seed = 1 ----
fit <- rstan::sampling(
  model,
  data   = model_data,
  chains = 4,
  iter   = 100000,
  warmup = 50000,
  seed   = 1
)

print(summary(fit, pars = c("alpha", "beta")))

## ---- posterior means of alpha and beta ----
samps <- fit$extract(pars = c("alpha", "beta"))
alpha_mean <- mean(samps$alpha)
beta_mean  <- mean(samps$beta)

writeLines(formatC(alpha_mean, format = "f", digits = 6), "/app/posterior_alpha_mean.txt")
writeLines(formatC(beta_mean,  format = "f", digits = 6), "/app/posterior_beta_mean.txt")

cat("posterior mean alpha:", format(alpha_mean, digits = 8), "\n")
cat("posterior mean beta :", format(beta_mean,  digits = 8), "\n")
